assets.name: coverage-50
assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational product illustration. Create ONE centered straight-on circular embroidered patch for a 50% /75% /100% coverage comparison. This is the 50% version. Identical master design to preserve in later variants: round patch, narrow navy merrowed edge, simple navy triangular mountain range filling the entire lower half with three ivory snowcaps, one small gold sun in upper right. Cream twill background. Approximately 50 percent of the interior is embroidered (the mountain lower half and sun); the upper half sky is visibly unstitched cream twill with diagonal weave. Threadwork is finely directional and visibly raised. No text, no labels, no logos. Centered circle occupies 80% of square image, authentic photorealistic embroidery, genuine transparent alpha background outside the circle. Clear educational distinction between matte flat twill and raised embroidered areas.

assets.name: coverage-75
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the EDIT TARGET, a master artwork for a technical embroidery coverage comparison. Create its 75% embroidery coverage version. Preserve EXACTLY the circle, diameter, framing, narrow navy edge, all three mountain silhouettes and snowcaps, gold sun position and size, camera and lighting, identical artwork colors. Change ONLY the texture of the cream sky: fill the lower half of the existing cream sky area with dense raised cream horizontal embroidery threads; leave the upper half of the sky as clearly visible flat diagonal-woven unstitched twill. This adds about 25% of the whole patch in stitched area, total approximately 75%. Do not add a line or new design element at the texture boundary. Keep the mountain and sun embroidery unchanged. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the patch. No labels, numbers, or text.

assets.name: coverage-100
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the EDIT TARGET, a master artwork for a technical embroidery coverage comparison. Create its 100% embroidery coverage version. Preserve EXACTLY the circle, diameter, framing, narrow navy edge, all three mountain silhouettes and snowcaps, gold sun position and size, camera and lighting, identical artwork colors. Change ONLY the texture of the cream sky: cover ALL the remaining exposed cream twill sky with dense raised cream horizontal embroidery threads, NO exposed twill fabric anywhere in the interior. Entire patch is now fully embroidered, approximately 100% coverage. Keep the mountain and sun embroidery unchanged. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the patch. No labels, numbers, or text.
